name: Áed Finn
text: Áed Finn, the fair Aed in Irish, is the author of the Imram Curaig Máile Dúin tale. One surviving manuscript names him the chief scholar of Ireland. A second Aed Finn appears in the annals with a death recorded in the year 777, as a king of Dál riada, though no mention of scholarly attainment appears there. The principal record sits under the imram headword.

attributes.attribute: Author of the Voyage of Máel Dúin's Boat; king of Dál Riada

okr.objective: Áed Finn is a MacKillop signpost to Imram Curaig Maile Dúin.
